card.name: Words before urgent treatment or digitalis
card.fires_on: Linking words such as requiring, including, and or an opening parenthesis that come right before a treatment named in a warning. Seen after serious infections (needing urgent surgery or hospitalization) and after heart failure therapy (before digitalis and diuretics).

modes.label: Infection requiring intervention
modes.description: The word requiring or urgent after a serious infection, leading into surgery or hospitalization.
modes.example: a rare life-threatening infection<< requiring>> urgent surgical intervention

modes.label: Heart failure therapy list
modes.description: A linking word or parenthesis after heart failure or conventional therapy, just before digitalis and diuretics.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that leads into the treatment a warning is about to name, such as surgery or digitalis.
